_about.what: DRAFT. Centre lines of every flexible thing in pmg.glb (Piano Memory Game), measured from the CAD: 109 jumper-wire bodies, 3 USB-cable bodies. Written by the PMG wire-path study, 19 Oct 2026; see docs/research/pmg/cad_wire_paths.md. Not yet in the kit folder: copy to "PMG Build Instructions/wire-paths.json" when the guide author takes it.
_about.units: millimetres, assembly space of pmg.glb (Y up), the pose each body is modelled in
_about.conductors: Top-level keys NAUOn: the round tube(s) of that instance, as the MRA/RCC files: solid (always 0: every body is one wire), radius_mm, length_mm, end_a / end_b = centres of the two flat end faces, dir_a / dir_b = the way the wire points out of each end, points = centre line from end_a to end_b every 1 mm (end faces exact), check = distance of the tube's side vertices from the line (equals the radius).
_about.jumper_wires: One entry per routed jumper-wire body, oriented from the device (button / display / matrix) to the I/O module: device + device_pin + device_cap, module + module_pin + module_cap, the two end points and directions, points. module_pin_as_expected = false marks a CAD slip (the wire is on the wrong module pin).
_about.wires: The 21 wires of the build in the published order: device pin, module pin, published step, colour in the published guide, and the body that draws it in each pose of the CAD (null = the pose exists but the CAD has no body for this wire).
_about.caps: Every Dupont cap: kind (Wire Cap 8 mm, Wire Cap V2 12 mm), centre, axis (unit, along its length), face_plus / face_minus = centres of its two end faces, the pin it sits on (device, pin) and the wire bodies that end in it.
_about.pins: Pin tips (assembly mm) of every device pose, and each pose's pin direction (the way the pin points, i.e. the way a cap is pushed off it). Module pins named "D4 G" etc. (row, column), as docs/research/mra/cad_pins.json.
_about.loose_wires: The straight 58 mm wires lying beside the bench (the published guide's "tokens", Steps 2 / 15 and every Step N of a wire), with the offsets the published guide gives them (Cadasio position minus CAD place, mm, by viewer step).
_about.usb: The USB cable in its three poses, from the right-angle Mini-B plug to the A end. radius 2.3 mm.
_about.colours: pmg.glb has a single default material: no wire has a colour of its own. Colours here are the published Cadasio guide's (hex), one per wire.
